description: Use when the user is choosing where to target, open, or send sales or media: "which Texas counties have the most high-income young households?", "which Harris County tracts concentrate households 65 and over?". Ranks the counties of a state, or the tracts of a county, by the number and the concentration of households with a householder in the chosen age bands and income range, from ACS 5-year estimates, with margins of error. Refuses before you are charged if the table does not reconcile. Every result carries a run id, a date and a citation line. Calling this tool returns a quote, not the result: what the run measures, its price and a payment_url. The run happens only when you POST to payment_url, and a run that fails its controls refuses there with nothing charged. Dimensions (vary these inputs to cut the answer; each call is its own run): over time: one release (ACS 2020-2024); place: state (counties) or county (tracts); segment: age_bands, income_min-income_max. Price: $0.05 per run over x402 (USDC on Base, no account needed), or $0.50 over MPP (a Stripe shared payment token); charged only when the run comes back sound. For the audience count with a margin of error, use run_audience_size.

age_bands.description: Householder age bands. Default all four.

county.description: Optional three-digit county FIPS code: ranks its tracts instead of the state’s counties.

income_max.description: Optional household income ceiling, at the same edges.
